text:
Yuki A.: quick note — ran a small smoke harness and reproduced a replay storm when auth keys rotated and client jitter was minimal. saw duplicate order creates across 3 clients.
Dan R.: can you paste repro and timestamps?
Yuki A.: steps: 1) start 3 runners `./load --clients 3 --burst 100 --seed 5` 2) rotate keys at t=2s 3) observe 429s then synced retries.
Logs:
```
WARN 2026-04-20T10:02:12Z retry: got 429 attempt=1 backoff_ms=10 jitter_ms=0
INFO 2026-04-20T10:02:12Z client: outgoing POST /v1/orders Idempotency-Key=(none)
ERROR 2026-04-20T10:02:12Z orders: duplicate detected order_87ab
```
Dan R.: two quick fixes: SDK should auto-generate idempotency keys when missing; and default jitter = full-jitter for hosted SDKs. also add env `REDWOOD_SDK_JITTER=full` for overrides.
QA Team: will run a matrix (jitter=[full,equal,none], idemp=[auto,none]) and report duplicate_rate.
Yuki A.: small UX ask — add `--debug-idemp` to loadgen to print generated keys so QA can correlate.
Dan R.: agreed. i'll open a tiny patch to sampleapp + sdk and add a deterministic jitter-seed flag for CI. TestBot: ci/run-replay-harness seed=5 triggered.
